name: chela
description: DEV ONLY — chela ships no npm dependencies. The dashboard's JS is hand-written ES modules served straight from chela/dashboard/static: nothing here is bundled, transpiled or shipped. This file exists for ONE reason: the DOM suites (tests/wall.test.mjs) run the REAL dashboard code in a REAL DOM (jsdom) under `node --test`, because the fake DOM they used to run against could not fail. tests/browser/ (CMX-383) additionally drives a real headless Chromium through playwright, because jsdom has no layout engine: `npm ci && npx playwright install --only-shell chromium`, then `npm run test:browser`. Run `npm ci` before `pytest`; CI does, and CHELA_REQUIRE_JS_TESTS=1 turns a missing jsdom into a failure rather than a silent skip.
